feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 20 November 2026 5:15pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 20 November 2026 at 5:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Clear spells this evening with a light and variable breeze, causing temperatures to fall close to 0°C for many parts of the island, but possibly down to -1°C for some places, leading to risk of frost and ice developing on any wet/damp untreated surfaces.

Remaining dry overnight as cloud cover increases along with the wind, allowing temperatures to recover later in the night.

Comments: Risk of frost and ice.

A cold start tomorrow with a risk of frost and ice in places.

A dry day ahead with sunny intervals, though getting breezier as the light or moderate southeasterly wind strengthens through the afternoon. Top temperature 10°C.

Comments: Risk of frost and ice at first. Strong winds developing.


##Outlook##

Dry with sunny spells on Sunday, turning cloudier later in the day, with a strong easterly wind easing through the afternoon, becoming moderate in the evening. Top temperature 9°C.

Comments: Risk of coastal overtopping (AM). Strong winds.

7:56am Tomorrow


##Sunset##

4:10pm Tomorrow
